description: The rad mutants denning past the Meltline have started pushing east into Slake's patch, and a fringe outfitter with a shop full of people to protect can't have that. Two of them, dropped, buys her breathing room and buys you a fistful of RadAway.
name: Over the Meltline

objectives.desc: Kill 2 rad mutants at the Meltline or Vex Hollow
